carbon_credit_batch_on_chain.description: Cache of CarbonCreditBatchNFT data minted on the OGCR chain (chain id 2025). One record per batch token. A batch is one (activity_nft_id, credit_type) pair, and each batch owns an ERC-6551 token-bound account that holds its CarbonCredit (ERC-20) balance. Populated by OGCR-chain-cache reading the chain. Join to `activity_on_chain` on activity_nft_id = token_id to reach the OBP activity.

batch_key.description: Business key for this record: "<activity_nft_id>:<credit_type>". Mirrors the contract's own uniqueness constraint (batchKey = keccak256(activity_nft_id, credit_type)), which allows exactly one batch per pair. Used to match records for upsert, since a string key can be filtered server-side where an integer token_id cannot be relied on to be.

token_id.description: CarbonCreditBatchNFT token id, unique per contract. Records are matched on batch_key rather than this, so that the match uses a string field.

credit_type.description: CRCF unit category this batch represents, as stored on-chain. A batch is unique per (activity_nft_id, credit_type).

activity_nft_id.description: ActivityNFT token id this batch was issued against. Join to `activity_on_chain`.token_id to reach the OBP activity_id.

activity_url.description: activity_url stored on-chain: link back to the OBP activity entity.

activity_hash.description: activity_hash stored on-chain: keccak256 of the raw activity entity body.

operator_url.description: operator_url stored on-chain: link back to the OBP operator entity.

operator_hash.description: operator_hash stored on-chain: keccak256 of the raw operator entity body.

certification_url.description: certification_url stored on-chain: link back to the OBP certificate_of_compliance entity.

certification_hash.description: certification_hash stored on-chain: keccak256 of the raw certificate entity body.

certification_scheme_url.description: certification_scheme_url stored on-chain: link back to the OBP certification_scheme entity.

certification_scheme_hash.description: certification_scheme_hash stored on-chain: keccak256 of the raw certification scheme entity body.

certification_body_url.description: certification_body_url stored on-chain: link back to the OBP certification body entity.

certification_body_hash.description: certification_body_hash stored on-chain: keccak256 of the raw certification body entity body.

token_bound_account.description: ERC-6551 token-bound account for this batch. This address holds the batch's CarbonCredit (ERC-20) balance.

credit_balance.description: CarbonCredit (ERC-20) balance held by token_bound_account, in smallest units, as read at block_number_balance. Decimal string because a uint256 does not fit an integer field. Divide by 10^credit_decimals for tonnes CO2e. Empty when no CarbonCredit contract address is configured.

credit_decimals.description: Decimals of the CarbonCredit ERC-20, for rendering credit_balance. 0 when no CarbonCredit contract address is configured.

credit_contract_address.description: CarbonCredit ERC-20 contract address the balance was read from.

block_number_balance.description: Block height the credit_balance was read at. Unlike the mint fields, the balance is current-state, not historical, so it is only true as of this block.

owner_address.description: Current owner of the batch NFT (operator OGCR wallet address). Owning the NFT gates the right to move the credits held in its token-bound account.

token_uri.description: tokenURI of the NFT (ERC721 metadata data-URI, rendered on-chain from the batch data).

contract_address.description: CarbonCreditBatchNFT contract address the token was read from.

tx_hash.description: Mint transaction hash (from the BatchMinted event).

block_number.description: Block number the mint was included in.
